messages:
maria: Quick triage - Bermuda LoRA on galena-13b (4-bit) shows numeric scaling errors in invoice smoke pack. Anyone free?
raj: Paste a repro please.
maria: Example:
User: "Total due: $7.50"
Model: "Total: $750"
Also: "Balance: 3,210.00 USD" -> "321000 USD"
sophia: Sounds like tokenizer merges concatenated the digit+comma groups. Did converter apply adapter BPE merges over base?
drew: Converter default can prefer adapter merges. Check pipeline logs for merge_vocab step.
ci-bot: build/bermuda-lora/quick-token-check queued by sophia (job #9001).
sophia: Token debug dump shows base tokens ["3", ",", "210", ".", "00"] -> adapter merged "321000".
raj: Blocker. Short fix: re-run conversion with --prefer-base-merges and re-quantize. Add unit test for comma-decimal patterns.
drew: I'll open a small PR with flag + test and re-run quantize.
maria: After that, run targeted evalpack on 50 invoice prompts. If numeric accuracy recovers, we can canary.
ci-bot: job #9001 completed (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/9001).
